newsitem.title: USA: US approves Trusted Info encryption.
newsitem.headline: US approves Trusted Info encryption.

text.p: Trusted Information Systems said Monday products using strong cryptography with its RecoverKey technology have been approved for general purpose export control under U.S. Commerce Department rules.

Among the products receiving this approval were the TIS Gauntlet Internet Firewall with both the 56-bit Data Encryption Standard algorithm and Triple-DES, and its Cryptographic Service Provider, the company said.
The new Commerce Department regulations determine whether or not hardware and software products that use encrypted messages can be exported.
